Welcome to Da Vinci's Dream, a registered 501(c)(3) nonprofit animal rescue based in Kentucky dedicated to saving dogs and cats through foster care, responsible adoption, transport coordination, and community outreach.

Our animals come from high-risk shelters, neglect cases, and urgent rescue situations. Each animal is placed in foster care, where we learn about personality, routine, and ideal home placement before adoption.

Through adoption, transport, and community support, our volunteers work to give vulnerable animals a second chance and connect them with loving forever homes.

If you are interested in adopting, fostering, or supporting our mission, visit davincisdream.org to learn more about our adoption process, available animals, and transport options.

Subscribe to follow rescue stories, available animals, and the daily work behind foster-based rescue in Kentucky.
